decisions.reason: The safety shoe line is core to the firm's announced direction and was upgraded to its own page in 2024, which signals growing visible commitment.
The comfort insole received only modest visibility, but it complements the work shoe range at low cost, and a weak start can still be read as a temporary ramp-up.
The supportive insole stays only mentioned, which shows limited commitment, but it fits the ergonomic work-shoe strategy and costs little to keep.
The ergonomic series has had its own page since launch, so it carries a high public commitment and is central to the firm's ergonomics positioning.
Firefighter boots required substantial certification and development investment, and their visibility rose in 2024, so management will persist with them.
The FIT Insole is featured on the home page with a public reference customer (ALBA Braunschweig), so the firm is highly and publicly committed to it.
